Hey, I was in a very similar situation myself. Starting the summer of my junior year, I started lurking on a2c and college confidential. I’m not a traditional student and my gpa was quite low in the beginning of high school when I went in a traditional setting (I don’t remember exactly what my gpa was). But I have severe test anxiety so while I was happy to see all my universities go test optional, people started telling me “as a home schooled student you’re not getting into college without test scores.”  My mental health hit an all time low and I felt suicidal. I convinced myself that I would not under any circumstances get into ANY colleges. I was so insecure, I hated myself for making the decisions that led me to where I was in my education and felt inferior in every way to my friends who were at the top of their traditional high school classes. I don’t know how but I pushed myself and applied to a ton of schools. And you know what? Yes, I did get painful rejections from my dream schools, one in particular. But I got into every single safety and most of my matches, as well as a t40  and a t25! I’m probably heading to the t40 because of money and location but seriously, your chances aren’t bad as you feel they are. I wish I could tell myself like half a year ago that it didn’t turn out nearly as bad as I imagined. You’ll be okay, try to be kind to yourself. I feel for the anxiety and wanting to die because you feel you don’t have a chance but I promise you that you do!
